hook_text: There is one equation every business on Earth obeys, every second of every day, and it fits on a sticky note.
clip_script: A new driving school. Owner puts in eighty thousand rand. Left pan of the scale: eighty thousand in the bank. Right pan: eighty thousand from the owner. Level. Borrows forty thousand: left one twenty, right eighty plus forty owed. Level. Buys a car for one hundred thousand: bank down, car up, both on the left. Still one twenty. Level. A learner pays twelve thousand for lessons: bank up, owner's share up. Wages and fuel: bank down, owner's share down. Level. That is the accounting equation: assets equal owner's equity plus liabilities. What you own equals what the owner put in plus what you owe. Every transaction, every business, forever. Write it down: A equals OE plus L.
visual_style: A whiteboard balance scale with a bank and a car on the left pan, the owner and a bank loan on the right, weights shifting with each transaction while the beam stays level.
mood: Calm and satisfying, a small truth with big power.
pacing: One transaction per beat, the scale levelling each time, a slow final write-out of the equation.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and keep the scale level through a whole month.
